modules.GameConfig.StudioTesting.Enabled=true
modules.GameConfig.StudioTesting.StartingHeroLevels.Knight=10

heroes.Stop()
assert(economy.GetGold(p1)==1000000000000 and progression.GetHeroLevel(p1,'Knight')==10)
assert(progression.GetUpgradeState(p1,'Knight','SharpenedBlade')=='Available')
assert(progression.GetUpgradeState(p1,'Knight','KnightTraining')=='Locked')
assert(progression.GetHeroDamage(p1,'Knight',false)==40,'unlock cannot automatically multiply')
local raw=modules.HeroConfig.Knight.BaseDamage
local gold=economy.GetGold(p1)
assert(progression.BuyUpgrade(p1,'Knight','SharpenedBlade'))
assert(economy.GetGold(p1)==gold-100 and progression.GetHeroDamage(p1,'Knight',false)==80)
assert(progression.GetUpgradeState(p1,'Knight','SharpenedBlade')=='Purchased')
advance(0.3)
local ok,reason=progression.BuyUpgrade(p1,'Knight','SharpenedBlade')
assert(not ok and reason=='AlreadyPurchased' and economy.GetGold(p1)==gold-100)
advance(0.3); gold=economy.GetGold(p1)
ok,reason=progression.BuyUpgrade(p1,'Knight','KnightTraining')
assert(not ok and reason=='Locked' and economy.GetGold(p1)==gold)
local milestoneAt={ [25]='KnightTraining',[50]='TreasureHunter',[100]='SwordMastery',[150]='BattleInspiration',[200]='LegendaryKnight' }
for level=10,199 do
 advance(0.3)
 local damage=progression.GetHeroDamage(p1,'Knight',false)
 assert(progression.BuyHeroLevel(p1,'Knight'))
 local id=milestoneAt[level+1]
 if id then
  assert(progression.GetUpgradeState(p1,'Knight',id)=='Available')
  local before=progression.GetHeroDamage(p1,'Knight',false)
  assert(before>=damage)
  advance(0.3); assert(progression.BuyUpgrade(p1,'Knight',id))
  assert(progression.GetUpgradeState(p1,'Knight',id)=='Purchased')
 end
end
assert(progression.GetGoldMultiplier(p1)==1.25)
assert(modules.HeroConfig.Knight.BaseDamage==raw,'base config must not be mutated')
local expected=math.floor(20*1.08^199*2*2*5*1.25*10+0.5)
assert(progression.GetHeroDamage(p1,'Knight',false)==expected)
for i=1,10 do assert(progression.GetHeroDamage(p1,'Knight',false)==expected) end
local data=p1:WaitForChild('HeroProgression'):WaitForChild('Knight')
assert(data:GetAttribute('Damage')==expected and data:GetAttribute('Level')==200)
for _,upgrade in modules.HeroConfig.Knight.Milestones do assert(data.Upgrades:GetAttribute(upgrade.Id)=='Purchased') end
print('PASS: levels 10/25/50/100/150/200 unlock without activation, configured purchases and costs, duplicate prevention, all Knight effects, no permanent/double stacking, replicated states')
security:
modules.GameConfig.StudioTesting.Enabled=true
modules.GameConfig.StudioTesting.StartingHeroLevels.Knight=10

heroes.Stop()
local gold=economy.GetGold(p1)
for _,payload in {{'Knight','SharpenedBlade',0},{'Knight','SharpenedBlade',2,0},{'Knight'}} do
 upgradeRemote.OnServerEvent:Fire(p1,table.unpack(payload))
 assert(economy.GetGold(p1)==gold and progression.GetUpgradeState(p1,'Knight','SharpenedBlade')=='Available')
end
for _,payload in {{0,'SharpenedBlade'},{'NoSuchHero','SharpenedBlade'},{'Knight','UnknownUpgrade'},{'Knight',{}},{string.rep('A',65),'SharpenedBlade'}} do
 advance(0.3); upgradeRemote.OnServerEvent:Fire(p1,table.unpack(payload))
 assert(economy.GetGold(p1)==gold and progression.GetHeroDamage(p1,'Knight',false)==40)
end
p1.HeroProgression.Knight.Upgrades:SetAttribute('SharpenedBlade','Purchased')
p1.HeroProgression.Knight:SetAttribute('Level',200)
p1:SetAttribute('Gold',999999999999)
assert(progression.GetUpgradeState(p1,'Knight','SharpenedBlade')=='Available')
assert(progression.GetHeroLevel(p1,'Knight')==10 and progression.GetHeroDamage(p1,'Knight',false)==40)
economy.SpendGold(p1,gold)
advance(0.3); local ok,reason=progression.BuyUpgrade(p1,'Knight','SharpenedBlade')
assert(not ok and reason=='NotEnoughGold' and progression.GetHeroDamage(p1,'Knight',false)==40)
economy.AddGold(p1,100)
advance(0.3); upgradeRemote.OnServerEvent:Fire(p1,'Knight','SharpenedBlade')
assert(economy.GetGold(p1)==0 and progression.GetHeroDamage(p1,'Knight',false)==80)
local count=#upgradeRemote.Responses
upgradeRemote.OnServerEvent:Fire(p1,'Knight','SharpenedBlade')
assert(#upgradeRemote.Responses==count and progression.GetHeroDamage(p1,'Knight',false)==80)
assert(economy.GetGold(p1)==0)
print('PASS: malformed/extra fields, nonexistent heroes/upgrades, client value/state spoofing, affordability, request throttling and duplicate purchases')

assert(ok and progression.GetHeroLevel(p1,'Knight')==200 and count==145 and economy.GetGold(p1)>=0)
advance(.3);ok,reason=progression.BuyHeroLevels(p1,'Knight','NEXT');assert(not ok and reason=='MaxLevel')
